secret.replaceHint: The stored value is never shown. What you type here replaces it when you save.
secret.setHint: Stored sealed when you save; it is never shown again.

copyOnce.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
copyOnce.hint: Shown only now. Store it somewhere safe.

settingsForm.reloaded: Reloaded their version; your edits were dropped
settingsForm.invalid: Stored value is not valid; the default is used
settingsForm.unsupported: {{label}}: this admin cannot edit settings of the kind “{{kind}}”.
settingsForm.fixFirst: Some settings need fixing before they can be saved.

account.title: Account
account.description: Your profile, how you sign in, API tokens, connected AI assistants and the sessions signed in as you.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your name as others see it, and the e-mail address password resets go to.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing it signs out every other session. API tokens keep working.

totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.description: A six-digit code from an authenticator app, asked for after your password.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: For scripts and other programs. A token can do only what its scopes and your role allow.

apps.title: Connected apps
apps.description: AI assistants you connected through MCP. Each acts as you, with the permissions you approved.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Browsers signed in as you. Sign out any you do not recognise.

profile.emailChangeHint: Password resets are sent to this address, so changing it needs your password.
profile.emailInvalid: Enter an e-mail address like name@example.com.
profile.passwordForEmail: Enter your current password to change your e-mail.

totp.onBody: Signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
totp.offBody: Signing in needs only your password. Add a code from your phone so a stolen password is not enough.
totp.lostHint: There are no recovery codes: if you lose the app, an administrator has to turn this off for you.
totp.stepScan: Step 1 of 2: scan the code with an authenticator app.
totp.stepCode: Step 2 of 2: enter the code the app shows, and your password.
totp.qrLabel: Scan this code with your authenticator app
totp.manual: Can't scan it? Enter this key instead
totp.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the key and copy it yourself.
totp.codeHint: The code changes every 30 seconds; use the newest one.
totp.codeWrong: That code is not right. Check that your phone's clock is set automatically, then try the newest code.
totp.expired: This set-up has expired. Start again for a new key.
totp.othersNote: Turning it on signs out your other sessions.
totp.disableBody: Signing in will need only your password. Enter it to confirm.

tokens.label: API tokens
tokens.revokeBody: Anything that uses this token stops working at once. This cannot be undone.
tokens.emptyBody: Create one for a script or another program that works with this site.
tokens.full: You have {{max}} tokens, the most an account can hold. Revoke one to make a new one.

tokenDialog.title: New API token
tokenDialog.description: A bearer token for the API. It can do only what you can, narrowed to the scopes below.
tokenDialog.name: Name
tokenDialog.nameHint: What uses it, so you know which one to revoke later.
tokenDialog.scopesHint: Write includes read. Only scopes this session holds are offered.

sessions.label: Sessions
sessions.signOutLabel: Sign out the session signed in {{when}}
sessions.onlyThis: No other session is signed in as you.

users.title: Users
users.description: Everyone who can sign in to this admin: their roles, how they sign in, and their API tokens.

noMatch.title: No users match
noMatch.body: No user has this role and status.
noMatch.bodyQ: No login, name or e-mail holds “{{q}}” with these filters.

new.title: New user
new.description: They sign in with the login or the e-mail address. The login cannot change later.
new.passwordHint: They must change it when they first sign in. Pass it on to them yourself; it is not shown again.
new.resetHint: The account is made without a password, and a link to choose one is e-mailed to them. The link expires after a while; if it does, they can ask for a new one with “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page, or you can set a password for them.
new.resetSent: A reset link was sent to {{email}}
new.resetFailed: The account was made, but the reset e-mail was not sent: {{detail}}

form.loginHint: Lower-case letters, digits, “.”, “_” and “-”; at most 60.
form.loginInvalid: Use 1 to 60 of a–z, 0–9, “.”, “_” and “-”, starting with a letter or digit.
form.emailInvalid: Enter an e-mail address like name@example.com.

sheet.description: A user's profile, role, sign-in and API tokens.
sheet.reloaded: Reloaded their account as it is now; your change was not saved.
sheet.ownBody: This is you. Your role and status cannot be changed here, and your profile, password and two-factor settings are in your account.
sheet.accessHint: A change asks first: it signs them out everywhere.
sheet.passwordBody: Set a new one if they lost theirs.
sheet.passwordMustReset: They must change their password at their next sign-in.
sheet.twoFactorOff: Off. Only they can turn it on, in their account.
sheet.tokensHint: Only they can make new tokens, in their account.
sheet.tokensHintOwn: Make new tokens in your account.
sheet.dangerBody: Removes the account for good. Content they wrote is kept and moves to another user.

access.roleBody: Their sessions end on every node, so they sign in again. Their API tokens stay, and can do only what the new role allows.
access.disableBody: They can no longer sign in: their sessions end and their API tokens are revoked. Their content stays.
access.enableBody: They can sign in again. API tokens revoked when the account was disabled do not come back.

password.title: Set a password for {{name}}
password.body: They must change it when they next sign in, and their sessions end now. Their API tokens keep working.
password.label: New password

totp.title: Turn off two-factor authentication for {{name}}?
totp.body: For a lost authenticator. They then sign in with their password alone until they set it up again. Their sessions and tokens are kept.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: The account is removed for good: their sessions end and their API tokens are revoked.
delete.reassign: This user owns content. Reassign it to:
delete.reassignHint: Their posts, pages and revisions move to that user; nothing is deleted.
delete.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, login or e-mail…
delete.nobody: There is no other active user.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: How the site is named, what its home page shows, where its pages live and how comments are handled.
settings.reloaded: Reloaded their version; your edits were dropped
settings.fixFirst: Some settings need fixing before they can be saved.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: Your changes to these settings are not saved yet. Leaving drops them.

errors.control: Remove the control characters (such as tabs).
errors.locale: Use 1 to 35 letters, digits, “-” or “_”, such as en or pt-BR.
errors.integer: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

permalink.slashes: Start and end the structure with “/”.
permalink.unknownToken: “{{segment}}” is not a token: a segment is one token or plain text.
permalink.uppercase: “{{segment}}” has capital letters; addresses are lower case.
permalink.reserved: “{{segment}}” is reserved and cannot start an address.
permalink.noParentPath: Pages need %parent_path%, or sub-pages would share addresses.
permalink.routeWord: “{{segment}}” starts author, page or search addresses and cannot start this one.
permalink.year: “{{segment}}” looks like a year archive and cannot start an address.

localeList.empty: The site needs at least one language.
localeList.badTag: One of the tags is not a language tag, such as de or pt-BR.
localeList.duplicate: Two languages have the same tag.
localeList.labelTooLong: A label has more than 50 characters.

general.title: General
general.description: The site's name, tagline and language.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: The languages the site is written in. The first is the default; every other one gets its own address prefix, such as /de/.

reading.title: Reading
reading.description: What the home page shows, how many posts a listing holds, and search engines.

permalinks.title: Permalinks
permalinks.description: The addresses of posts and pages.

comments.title: Comments
comments.description: Whether posts take comments and which wait for moderation.

mediaSizes.title: Media sizes
mediaSizes.description: The image sizes made for every uploaded image.

mail.title: Mail
mail.description: Outgoing e-mail for password resets and plugin notices.

aiAssistants.title: AI assistants
aiAssistants.description: Let Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other assistants manage this site through MCP, as the person who connects them.

general.title: Site title
general.titleHint: Shown in the browser tab, feeds and e-mails. Leave empty to use the title in ferrite.toml.
general.taglineHint: A short line about the site, used by themes and feeds. Leave empty to use the one in ferrite.toml.
general.localeHint: A language tag such as en or pt-BR, for the pages' lang attribute and the feed. Leave empty to use the one in ferrite.toml.

reading.latestPostsHint: The newest posts first, a page at a time.
reading.aPageHint: A page of your choice; the post listing then has no address of its own.
reading.pageGoneHint: The chosen page no longer exists or cannot be read; choose another.
reading.notPublished: This page is not published: the home page shows the latest posts until it is.
reading.perPageHint: 1 to 100, for the home page and archives. Leave empty for the default, {{value}}.
reading.discourageHint: robots.txt then asks every crawler to stay away. Crawlers that ignore robots.txt may still index the site.
reading.nameFailed: The chosen page could not be loaded.

permalinks.customHint: Build your own from the tokens below.
permalinks.pageHint: Must contain %parent_path%: a sub-page's address holds its parents'. The default is {{default}}.

tokenHints.parent_path: The parents' slugs, empty for a top-level item

permalinks.noPreview: Fix the structure to see a preview.
permalinks.otherTypes: Items of custom content types stay at /t/<type>/<slug>/.

confirm.title: Change the permalinks?
confirm.body: Every post or page whose address follows the changed structure moves to a new URL. Redirects from the old URLs are created in the background, so links to them elsewhere keep working after a short moment.

comments.knownHint: A guest with an approved comment under the same name and e-mail posts without waiting. Anyone who knows those two can post as them.
comments.allHint: Each guest comment waits for a moderator.
comments.perPageHint: 1 to 100 top-level threads on each public page, with all their replies. Leave empty for the default, {{value}}.

mediaSizes.none: The theme {{theme}} asks for no sizes of its own.
mediaSizes.name: Name

skipped.noCrop: A size with a height must be cropped.
skipped.taken: FerriteCMS already makes a size of this name.

mediaSizes.noActiveBody: The site serves the built-in theme until one is activated.
mediaSizes.needsThemes: Seeing the theme's sizes needs permission to manage themes.
mediaSizes.changeNote: Sizes are not a setting: to change them, change the theme (its theme.toml [images]). FerriteCMS also makes its own sizes: {{sizes}}.

mail.configuredHint: Password resets and plugin notices are sent by e-mail.
mail.notConfiguredHint: Password resets by e-mail and plugin notices are off.
mail.setupRestart: Then restart ferrite serve. The SMTP URL can also come from smtp_url_file or FERRITE_MAIL__SMTP_URL.
mail.testNeedsSystem: Sending a test e-mail needs System access.

languages.tagHint: Such as de, fr or pt-BR.
languages.label: Label
languages.badTag: Not a language tag. Use a language like de, optionally with a region like pt-BR.
languages.duplicate: The site has this language already.

changeDefault.title: Change the default language?
changeDefault.body: Content in {{from}} will move under its own prefix and content in {{to}} will lose its prefix. Old addresses are not redirected.

themes.title: Themes
themes.description: How the public site looks. Upload a theme folder, switch the active theme and customize it.

nodes.title: Served by
nodes.fallbackHint: This node cannot load the theme and keeps serving its previous one.
nodes.pending: Some nodes have not loaded {{name}} yet. Their state shows here when they report it.

confirm.title: Activate {{name}}?
confirm.body: The public site switches to this theme on every node as soon as each one loads it. {{current}} stays installed and can be activated again.
confirm.bodyNoCurrent: The public site switches to this theme on every node as soon as each one loads it.
confirm.doesNotLoad: The theme does not load, so nothing changed:

uploadDialog.title: Upload a theme
uploadDialog.description: A theme folder holds theme.toml, templates/ and assets/. Folders are packed in your browser; hidden files are left out.
uploadDialog.drop: Drop a theme folder or a .tar bundle here
uploadDialog.dropOther: Drop one theme folder or one .tar file.
uploadDialog.unknownName: Theme name not found in theme.toml
uploadDialog.replace: A theme named {{name}} is installed (version {{version}}). Uploading replaces it.
uploadDialog.replaceActive: A theme named {{name}} is installed (version {{version}}) and it is the active theme. Uploading replaces it, and the new files go live on the site at once.
uploadDialog.doesNotLoad: The theme does not load, so nothing was installed:

pack.too-many-files: The folder has more than 2000 files.
pack.too-large: The folder's files add up to more than 20 MiB.
pack.path-too-long: {{path}}: the path is longer than 255 bytes.
pack.bad-path: {{path}}: the path has a backslash, a control character or an empty segment.
pack.too-deep: {{path}}: folders are nested deeper than 16 levels.
pack.does-not-fit: {{path}}: the path does not fit a tar header (the file name after the last folder must be at most 100 bytes).

settings.title: Customize {{name}}
settings.description: Options the theme declares in theme.toml. They apply on every page the theme renders.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Extensions that run in a sandbox, each with only the access it was approved for.

report.nothing: This plugin asks for no access to the site.

install.title: Install a plugin
install.description: A plugin is its ferrite-plugin.toml and one .wasm component. You see what it asks for before anything is installed.
install.drop: Drop ferrite-plugin.toml and the .wasm file here
install.dropHint: Or choose each file. The component may be up to 32 MiB.
install.changed: The files changed after the check, so nothing was installed. This is what they ask for now: review it and approve again.
install.update: This updates the installed {{name}} (version {{version}}); it stays enabled or disabled as it is.
install.updateNoVersion: This updates the installed {{name}}; it stays enabled or disabled as it is.
install.somethingNew_one: It asks for {{count}} new permission, marked New.
install.somethingNew_other: It asks for {{count}} new permissions, marked New.
install.doneHint: It runs on the site once you enable it.
install.doneEnabledHint: The update was already enabled, so it runs as soon as each node loads it.

plugins.broken: This plugin does not load: its stored manifest or grant no longer reads. Install it again, or delete it.
plugins.disabledReason: Disabled automatically after repeated failures: {{reason}}. Enabling it starts its failure count over.

empty.title: No plugins installed
empty.body: Plugins add features in a sandbox, with only the access you approve. Install one from its manifest and .wasm file.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: The live nodes that loaded this plugin.
nodes.none: No live node has loaded it yet: it is disabled, or the nodes have not reported.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: What this plugin was approved for when it was installed.
permissions.broken: The stored grant does not read, so nothing is shown.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Options the plugin declares in its manifest. Secrets are never shown again once saved.
settings.invalid_one: {{count}} stored value no longer fits this version and reads as its default until you save it again.
settings.invalid_other: {{count}} stored values no longer fit this version and read as their defaults until you save them again.

metrics.noFailures: No failures in the last {{hours}} hours.
metrics.noCalls: No calls on this node since it started.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Its hooks and routes stop at once on every node.
delete.keepBody: If you keep its data, its stored data, settings and secrets stay for 30 days: a plugin named {{name}} installed in that time picks them up again, whoever publishes it. Erase them if you do not plan to reinstall it.
delete.doneKept: {{name}} deleted; its data is kept for 30 days

retained.title: Retained data
retained.description: Data, settings and secrets of deleted plugins, kept for 30 days. Installing a plugin of the same name before then picks them up again.
retained.name: Plugin
retained.confirmBody: Its stored data, settings and secrets are deleted now. This cannot be undone.
retained.alreadyErased: The data of {{name}} was already erased

system.title: System
system.description: Versions, nodes, background jobs and the audit log.

upToDate.title: Up to date
upToDate.body: The database is at version {{db}}, the version this binary expects.

needsUp.body_one: The database is at version {{db}} and this binary expects {{binary}}. Apply it with ferrite migrate up.
needsUp.body_other: The database is at version {{db}} and this binary expects {{binary}}. Apply them with ferrite migrate up.

newer.title: Newer database, still compatible
newer.body: A newer FerriteCMS moved the database to version {{db}}; this binary knows up to {{binary}} and can still run on it. Upgrade this binary when you can.

incompatible.title: Incompatible
incompatible.body: The database is at version {{db}}, which this binary (version {{binary}}) cannot run on. Upgrade this binary.

schema.unknown: The database is at version {{db}}; this binary knows up to {{binary}}.

mail.title: Mail
mail.configuredHint: Password resets and plugin notices are sent by e-mail.
mail.notConfiguredHint: Password resets by e-mail and plugin notices are off. Mail is set up in ferrite.toml.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.hint: A node is live while its last heartbeat is at most 30 s old.

skew.ahead: Clock {{seconds}} s ahead of the database

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.error: The plugins could not be read

jobs.unhandled: No node handles this kind yet

retry.queuedUnhandled: Queued again. No node handles this kind yet
retry.unhandledHint: It waits until a node that runs {{kind}} jobs joins.

empty.title: No jobs yet
empty.body: Background work such as scheduled publishing, image sizes and plugin actions shows here.
empty.statusBody: Nothing with this status right now.

audit.systemHint: Not done through a signed-in account: the command line or an e-mailed link.

action.label: Action
action.hint: Type a prefix ending in a dot, like user.

target.label: Target
target.idHint: Optional: one item of that kind.

empty.title: Nothing logged yet
empty.body: Changes to users, settings, themes, plugins and jobs are logged here.

user.totp_disable: Turned off a user's two-factor sign-in
